The '''compass''' comes in three pack variants, all working like the vanilla compass: the '''copper compass''', '''golden compass''' and '''titanium compass'''. They differ only in name and texture.

== Obtaining ==
* Copper compass: 4 copper ingots around electric wire.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/copper_compass.json}}</ref>
* Golden compass: 4 gold ingots around electric wire.
* Titanium compass: only from chest loot (shipwreck map chests, stronghold libraries and the special compass table).
When a compass is chosen at random, the weights are 6 copper, 3 gold and 1 titanium.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/equipment/compass/any_weighted.json}}</ref>
The vanilla compass recipe is still available.
